name: Rulebook AI
headline: Rulebook AI - Standardize AI Coding Instructions
short_description: Elevate vibe coding to vibe engineering: Get consistent Github Copilot custom instructions, Cursor, Roo Code, Cline, Windsurf, Claude Code, Gemini Cli, Codex CLI, kilo code, warp custom rules via a universal, managed template. Features vibe coding memory bank & best practices for large codebases.
author: botingw

sections.overview:
Rulebook-ai is a unified framework for managing custom instructions across multiple AI coding assistants, including Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Roo Code, and others. Instead of manually configuring separate custom instructions for each tool, rulebook-ai provides a managed template system that ensures consistency across your development environment. The tool includes a vibe coding memory bank and standardized best practices designed specifically for working with large codebases. It supports both individual tool configurations and community-driven rule packs, reducing friction when setting up AI agents and helping teams maintain coherent coding standards across different assistants.
Quickly onboard AI assistants with tailored rules for specific programming tasks.
Maintain consistent coding standards across different AI platforms without manual adjustments.
Easily switch between different project configurations using named profiles.
Collaborate with team members by sharing environment packs that encapsulate best practices.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/botingw/rulebook-ai`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
